important_comparison_caveat: This audit measures raw logits before generation processors. Prior greedy generation used repetition_penalty=1.12, so raw top-1 IDs need not match the first emitted token IDs. Do not interpret the 3 base/raw ID 4500 results as a contradiction or a proven root cause until processor-adjusted logits are audited.
interpretation: LoRA candidate shifts first-token raw top-1 toward ID 119 on this fixed 10-prompt holdout, but its mean raw first-token entropy rises rather than collapses. This does not establish why full greedy sequences repeat one token.
next_controlled_experiment: Compare raw versus repetition-penalty-adjusted first-step logits for the same prompts, then inspect conditional logits at later generation steps and manually review safe redacted samples.
data_handling: No raw prompts, generated text, credentials or secrets included.
